Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldBuilder.LineBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldBuilder.LineBuilder
Enclosing class:
SldBuilder
public static final class SldBuilder.LineBuilder extends Object
Full-featured builder for a <LineSymbolizer>.

Controls the full set of SVG stroke properties supported by SLD 1.0:

  • Stroke colour and width (set at construction via SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.stroke(String, double))
  • Dash pattern (dashArray(String)) and dash offset (dashOffset(double))
  • Line-cap style (lineCap(LineCap)) and line-join style (lineJoin(LineJoin))
  • Stroke-level opacity (strokeOpacity(double)) and symbolizer-level opacity (opacity(double))
  • Perpendicular offset from the line geometry (perpendicularOffset(double))
  • Graphic fill or graphic stroke (repeated marks/images along the line)

Call end() to finalize the symbolizer and return to the parent SldBuilder.RuleBuilder. 


 SldBuilder.create("roads").rule()
     .stroke("#CC0000", 2)
         .dashArray("4 2")
         .lineCap(LineCap.ROUND)
         .lineJoin(LineJoin.ROUND)
     .end().build();

1.0.0
